The third-generation retailer in downtown Boise will close in November, citing a downtown that no longer draws the foot traffic it once did.

Boise, Idaho—After 62 years on the same corner, Kessler & Sons Jewelers will close its doors in November, the family said this week.

The third-generation retailer cited shifting downtown foot traffic and rising rents, a combination that has already claimed several independents in the region over the past two years.

The family plans a liquidation sale in October and says its two bench jewelers have lined up positions with other stores, while longtime customers have begun stopping in to say goodbye.
